value.rationale: The exact degree-four projection is a natural structural decomposition of the two basic short cycle counts in a tournament, giving the best predictor in a whole polynomial subspace and a sharp, nonzero finite-sample relative error 1/(4n-11). It is not merely a table recomputation or a renaming of the known deterministic type-count identity.
